scripts.dev: npm run assets:generate && npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:log: npm run assets:generate && cross-env LOG_RELAY=1 LOG_LEVEL=info LOG_SYSTEMS=animation,stateMachine,messaging VITE_LOG_RELAY=true npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:log:info: npm run assets:generate && cross-env LOG_RELAY=1 LOG_LEVEL=info LOG_SYSTEMS=* VITE_LOG_RELAY=true npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:log:debug: npm run assets:generate && cross-env LOG_RELAY=1 LOG_LEVEL=debug LOG_SYSTEMS=* VITE_LOG_RELAY=true npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:log:trace: npm run assets:generate && cross-env LOG_RELAY=1 LOG_LEVEL=trace LOG_SYSTEMS=* VITE_LOG_RELAY=true npm run dev:server
scripts.wardrobe:generate: node scripts/generate-skins-manifest.js && node scripts/generate-wardrobe-parts.js && node scripts/generate-skin-previews.js
scripts.assets:generate: node scripts/generate-skins-manifest.js && node scripts/generate-animations-manifest.js && node scripts/generate-wardrobe-parts.js && node scripts/generate-skin-previews.js
scripts.assets:clean: npm run wardrobe:clean && npm run animations:clean
scripts.electron: cross-env VITE_SOCKET_ENABLED=true npm run build && electron .
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env VITE_SOCKET_ENABLED=true npm run build && electron .
scripts.pack: cross-env VITE_SOCKET_ENABLED=true npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: cross-env VITE_SOCKET_ENABLED=true npm run build && electron-builder
